git_scope: Blobless clone checked out at the pinned commit, which adds search/trio126/; no issue asked. The whole trio126 directory is retained: three n = 126 certificates with their binary64 and 70-digit exactsolve points, the README and its SHA256SUMS. The licence, credits, certificate-format README and the picture-to-packing tool the README names are retained beside it; the two exact checkers are pinned by digest against the identical copies the issue-399 packet retains. The rest of the tree is pinned by the commit and was not retained or executed.
